name: Rajasekar C
title: Data Engineer | Product Engineer
summary: Data Engineer with 5+ years building high-volume production systems, backend services, and data platforms. Experienced in SQL, Python, PostgreSQL, ETL, and production automation, supporting systems that process approximately 50 million records daily. Currently building independent software products from architecture through deployment.

bullets: Designed and built software products end to end, owning system architecture, backend, and deployment
Built backend services and REST APIs on PostgreSQL and Redis, adding caching and automated background jobs for reliability
Containerized and shipped services with Docker, managing source, releases, and CI-style workflows through Git and GitHub
Automated data indexing, metadata handling, and operational tasks to reduce manual effort and keep systems consistent
Leveraged AI-assisted development tools, including Cursor, Claude, and Codex, to accelerate prototyping, testing, and feature delivery
Built a Flask and Pandas automation tool that cut Vahan issue resolution from ~30 minutes to under 1 minute, earning the company "Tech Titan" award
Designed and ran ETL pipelines processing ~50M records/day, keeping downstream reporting accurate and timely
Automated MoEngage customer notifications through real-time stored procedures for policy-renewal detection, eliminating redundant alerts
Versioned PostgreSQL schemas by extracting DDL into Git, making deployments traceable, reviewable, and reproducible
Implemented PII classification and secure credential storage to keep data handling compliant
Delivered ETL pipelines and schemas for the Bima Satrak regulatory reporting service
Resolved 4000+ production issues, cutting the open backlog from ~600 to under 70
Automated recurring credit-update and Excel-to-database ingestion with SQL and Pandas, replacing manual runs
Built and maintained Oracle SQL and PL/SQL solutions, including stored procedures and reports, for banking and insurance production systems
Owned incident response for live banking and insurance systems, diagnosing root causes and deploying fixes to production
Tuned slow queries and stored procedures to improve database performance under high-usage production workloads
Managed deployments and database maintenance and recovery across client production environments
Founded and ran a construction business delivering residential and commercial projects end to end
Managed vendors, clients, budgets, and schedules across concurrent projects
Led site teams and daily operations, owning quality and on-time delivery
